info.name: Task Align - final postman collection(1-4)
info.description: Unified Postman Collection for Task Align Backend covering all endpoints across Member 1 (Authentication), Member 2 (Master Data & Reports), and Member 3 (Assignment Management, Resources, Tasks, Task Skills, Constraints, Preview, and Sprint 7 Business Rule Engine).

request.description:
Generates the Cost Matrix Preview before running Cost Minimization.
Uses optimizationType = COST_MINIMIZATION.
Returns assignment summary, eligible/ineligible resources, budget, timeline, and cost matrix.

Generates the Profit Matrix Preview before running Profit Maximization.
Uses optimizationType = PROFIT_MAXIMIZATION.
Returns assignment summary, eligible/ineligible resources, budget, timeline, and profit preview matrix.

Executes Hungarian Algorithm using Cost Minimization.
Returns optimized assignment, assignment cost, optimized matrix, budget status, timeline status and execution time.

Executes Hungarian Algorithm using Profit Maximization.
Returns optimized assignment, total saved money, optimized matrix, budget status, timeline status and execution time.

Returns final Cost Optimization result including:

• Assignment Summary
• Optimized Assignment
• Cost Matrix
• Total Assignment Cost
• Budget Status
• Timeline Status
• Execution Time

Returns final Profit Optimization result including:

• Assignment Summary
• Optimized Assignment
• Profit Matrix
• Total Assignment Cost
• Total Saved Money
• Budget Status
• Timeline Status
• Execution Time
